issue: The formula annotation says 'O = 300 output per turn', but the plotted 34.0 GB bar and the caption use a single final 300-token output. If 300 output tokens were added per turn, the total would be 13,860 tokens and ~36.3 GB, not 34.0 GB.
evidence: Figure 19.3 formula line: 'append-only total = I0 + T·δ + T·γ + O_final @ 2.62 MB/token (I0 = 9.2K input, δ = 800 retrieved, γ = 65 generated, O = 300 output per turn)'. The bar is labeled 34.0 GB. Recompute with O per turn: 9,200 + 4×800 + 4×65 + 4×300 = 13,860 tokens; 13,860 × 2.62 MB ≈ 36.3 GB. Recompute with one final output: 9,200 + 4×800 + 4×65 + 300 = 12,960 tokens; 12,960 × 2.62 MB ≈ 34.0 GB. The caption also says 'one final 300-token answer'.
acceptance_test: Change the annotation to 'O_final = 300 output once (final answer)' or equivalent, and verify the displayed 34.0 GB equals (9,200 + 4×800 + 4×65 + 300) × 2.62 MB.

issue: The figure note claims 'processed tokens grow ~2.5x under no prefix reuse', but the figure's own per-turn retained-context arithmetic implies a much larger summed per-call processed-token growth.
evidence: Figure 19.2 note: 'Bars are RETAINED context/KV, not summed per-call processed or billed tokens; processed tokens grow ~2.5x under no prefix reuse'. Using the figure's own values, summed per-call processed tokens for turns 0–4 are 9,500 + 10,365 + 11,230 + 12,095 + 12,960 = 56,150; versus 9,500 single-shot, that is ~5.9x, not ~2.5x. Excluding output tokens gives 54,650 / 9,200 ≈ 5.9x. The ~2.5x figure is not reproducible from the displayed model.
acceptance_test: Recompute the summed per-call processed-token ratio from the figure's own turn-by-turn values and either correct '~2.5x' to the derived value (~5.9x) or explicitly state the different denominator/scope that yields ~2.5x.

evidence: Rendered page 327 shows the note 'counterfactual: each column = a separate completion after T turns...' and the legend labels at a much smaller size than the caption and body text. The note spans the figure width and contains critical semantic qualifications.
